name: @pipeworx/mcp-startuphub

tools.name: startuphub_startups
tools.description: Search the StartupHub.ai startup database — returns startup profiles (name, domain, sector, funding, tech). Filter by free-text plus sector / tech stack / funding stage / stealth status. Example: startuphub_startups({ q: "anthropic", limit: 5, _apiKey: "your-key" })

q.description: Free-text query — company name, keyword, or description, e.g. "anthropic", "vector database"

limit.description: Max number of startups to return (default 10)

sector.description: Filter by sector / industry, e.g. "AI Infrastructure", "Fintech"

tech.description: Filter by technology in the company stack, e.g. "PyTorch", "Kubernetes"

funding.description: Filter by funding stage, e.g. "Seed", "Series A", "Series B"

stealth.description: If true, return only stealth-mode startups

country.description: Filter by country, e.g. "United States", "United Kingdom"

_apiKey.description: StartupHub.ai API key (get one at https://www.startuphub.ai (My Account → API, up to 3 keys) — docs: https://www.startuphub.ai/api-docs)

tools.name: startuphub_investors
tools.description: Search the StartupHub.ai investor database — returns investor profiles (name, type, focus sectors/stages, portfolio, location). Example: startuphub_investors({ q: "sequoia", limit: 5, _apiKey: "your-key" })

q.description: Free-text query — investor / fund name or keyword, e.g. "sequoia", "seed AI"

limit.description: Max number of investors to return (default 10)

sector.description: Filter by investor focus sector, e.g. "AI", "Climate"

stage.description: Filter by investment stage, e.g. "Seed", "Series A"

country.description: Filter by country / geography, e.g. "United States"

_apiKey.description: StartupHub.ai API key (get one at https://www.startuphub.ai (My Account → API, up to 3 keys) — docs: https://www.startuphub.ai/api-docs)

tools.name: startuphub_enrich
tools.description: Resolve a company domain into a full StartupHub.ai profile: firmographics, tech fingerprint, and funding history. Example: startuphub_enrich({ domain: "anthropic.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

domain.description: Company domain to enrich, e.g. "anthropic.com" (bare domain, no scheme)

_apiKey.description: StartupHub.ai API key (get one at https://www.startuphub.ai (My Account → API, up to 3 keys) — docs: https://www.startuphub.ai/api-docs)

tools.name: startuphub_trends
tools.description: Get the rolling AI-funding trends snapshot from StartupHub.ai — capital deployed, biggest rounds, and hot sectors / stages / exits. Example: startuphub_trends({ _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: StartupHub.ai API key (get one at https://www.startuphub.ai (My Account → API, up to 3 keys) — docs: https://www.startuphub.ai/api-docs)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-startuphub forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the startuphub pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
